scope: Independent pre-deletion review of the five exact local website checkouts, full local preservation, migration completeness and the cleanup guard. Actual deletion is not claimed by this review.

verified.sourceAndRestoredFileBytesModesPortableX: Independently recomputed and matched against all manifest entries.
verified.git: Independent git fsck --full, refs, and dirty status comparisons passed for all five restored checkouts.

guardReview: The exact five absolute paths and recorded root device/inode pairs are required; ajigu-site is excluded.
The complete backup manifest, full archive SHA256 values, source inventory, migration source/target digests and original persistent backup hashes are checked before any removal.
Source links and special files are rejected. Directory occupation must be absent, and unexpected lsof errors stop the operation.
Apply mode binds the independent review to the exact manifest, migration review, preservation helper and deletion guard SHA256 values.
Each original root is rechecked, renamed to a fixed unoccupied sibling staging path, rechecked for identity and complete inventory, then removed through symlink-resistant shutil.rmtree.
Parent app tracked files, unrelated dirty working files and other sibling directory identities are compared before each removal and afterward.
Partial receipts are retained after each successful removal; all retained backups are rechecked before a complete receipt.

After a verified same-volume staging rollback, source/staging comparisons ignore only the root directory com.apple.provenance attribute. All descendant attributes, root quarantine, file bytes and modes remain exact; six negative boundary checks passed, and the normalizer does not mutate its input.
metadataRestorationLimit: macOS may regenerate com.apple.provenance and com.apple.quarantine on extraction. Full source xattr hashes remain in the private manifest and the tar archives retain metadata. The independent restored-tree comparison excludes only these two attributes. All file bytes, modes and other recorded xattrs matched; no explicit ACL entries were found in the source trees.
remainingAcceptance: Run the reviewed apply guard and require its complete five-directory deletion receipt and final backup/protected-state checks. Do not treat this review as evidence that deletion has already occurred.

stagingDeltaReview.exception: Only entry . / xattrs / com.apple.provenance is excluded from source and staging equality. No other source metadata exception is introduced.
